name: Samsung Galaxy S25
shortDescription: Samsung Galaxy S25 5G with a 15.64 cm (6.2 inch) 120 Hz AMOLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy, 12 GB RAM and 256 GB storage, in Navy.
description:
The Samsung Galaxy S25 has a 15.64 cm (6.2 inch) FHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with a refresh rate of up to 120 Hz, and runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy processor with 12 GB RAM and 256 GB storage.

On the back are three cameras: 50 MP, 10 MP with 3x optical zoom, and 12 MP. The front camera is 12 MP. The phone records video in up to 8K at 30 fps.

The frame is Armor Aluminum, with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 on the front and back, and the phone is IP68 rated for dust and water resistance. It has a 4,000 mAh battery (typical), dual SIM with eSIM support, 5G, Wi-Fi 7 and NFC. It weighs 162 g and is 7.2 mm thin.

The Galaxy S25 runs Android with Samsung's One UI and Galaxy AI features. Samsung lists security updates for this model until 31 January 2032. A charger is not included in the box.
